pattern.short_summary: The same content is made available under two different presentation or interaction disciplines, and a selection determines which is in force.
pattern.definition: The same content is made available under two different presentation or interaction disciplines, and a selection determines which is in force. The modes differ in how the content is reached and acted on, not in what the content is. Only one mode operates at a time.
pattern.structural_signature: One content payload, two renderings with distinct interaction rules (push stream vs. pull query; predetermined navigation vs. free-form questioning; freeform text vs. structured fields; whole-document vs. extracted-terms conditioning), and a mode selector that makes one active. The modes are alternatives at the same point in the flow — either can serve the same user need — and switching between them does not change the underlying content. In several members the two modes are never both available to the same user; there the selector is the experimenter's assignment rather than a control (see the review flag).

dimension.category_description: How AI assistance is spatially composed with artifacts, panels, host tools, chat surfaces, presentation modes, and shared workspaces.
dimension.classification_boundary: Use for visible surface placement and integration, not sensory modality or physical-space registration.
